content_fields.title: Centralize authorization
content_fields.description: Route every authorization decision through one shared policy layer instead of re-implementing checks in individual handlers.
content_fields.finding: RolesBasedAuthChecker is the only shared authorization primitive and it covers roles alone; ownership and resource rules are re-implemented ad hoc in individual handlers.
criteria: All routes declare their requirement through the shared dependency.
No handler body contains an inline role comparison.
Adding a role or permission requires a change in exactly one module.
